name: Clock Glitching
description: Injection of clock signal perturbations to induce setup-time violations and computational faults. Covers clock frequency manipulation, insertion of extra clock edges, clock signal replacement, glitch timing characterization, and exploitation of clock-induced faults for security bypass and cryptographic key extraction.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to clock fault injection techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands clock glitching principles and setup-time violations
evidence: Can explain how clock glitches cause setup-time violations in synchronous logic
Understands the difference between clock glitching and voltage glitching fault models
Aware that clock glitching requires access to or manipulation of the target's clock signal (external clock, crystal replacement, or clock line injection)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs clock glitching on training targets with existing setups under supervision
evidence: Configures ChipWhisperer clock glitch module for a documented training target
Inserts clock glitches at target operations and observes fault effects
Systematically sweeps glitch timing parameters and records results
Demonstrates instruction skip or data corruption via clock glitch on a training platform

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently performs clock glitching on real targets including clock signal access
evidence: Identifies and accesses clock signals on target PCBs (crystal replacement, clock injection points)
Optimizes clock glitch parameters for new targets without documentation
Exploits clock-induced faults to bypass security checks or corrupt cryptographic computations
Completed clock glitching assessments on 3+ different target platforms independently

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Attacks targets with internal oscillators; develops custom clock manipulation hardware
evidence: Performs clock glitching on targets with internal oscillators via PLL manipulation or EM injection
Develops custom clock glitch insertion hardware for specialized targets
Combines clock glitching with other fault injection and side-channel techniques
Mentors team on clock signal identification, manipulation, and fault exploitation

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on clock fault injection; publishes research; defines methodology
evidence: Published research on novel clock glitching techniques or countermeasure evaluations
Defines the lab's clock fault injection methodology
Specifies, designs, and qualifies clock manipulation hardware adopted as lab reference equipment
Provides expert consultation on clock glitch resistance to hardware designers

assessment_methods.description: Access the clock signal on a prepared target, perform clock glitching, and demonstrate exploitation of induced faults
Observe clock signal identification, glitch insertion technique, and parameter optimization during a live session

equipment: ChipWhisperer-Husky or ChipWhisperer-Pro with clock glitch module
